Class MzTabReader

java.lang.Object
global.thalion.ttio.importers.MzTabReader
public final class MzTabReader extends Object
mzTab importer

Tab-separated text reader that maps PSM / PRT / SML rows into Identification and Quantification records suitable for inclusion in an .tio container's compound identification / quantification datasets.

Mode dispatch follows the MTD mzTab-version line per HANDOFF binding decision 47:

  • "1.0" — proteomics dialect (PSM/PRT)
  • "2.0.0-M" — metabolomics dialect (SML)

API status: Provisional ().

Cross-language equivalents: Python ttio.importers.mztab, Objective-C TTIOMzTabReader.

  • Field Details

    • PROGRESS_INTERVAL_ROWS

      public static final int PROGRESS_INTERVAL_ROWS
      Default emit-every-N cadence for ProgressSink callbacks during the row-parse phase. mzTab uses tabular rows (PRT / PEP / PSM / SML / SMF / SME), not spectra; 500 rows balances visible per-large-file updates against callback overhead.

    • read

      public static MzTabReader.MzTabImport read(Path path, ProgressSink progress) throws IOException
      Parse an mzTab file, firing progress.onProgress(rowsDone, -1L) every PROGRESS_INTERVAL_ROWS data rows (PRT / PEP / PSM / SML / SMF / SME) and a final onProgress(total, total) once the full row count is known. Total is reported as -1L mid-parse because mzTab gives no row count up front; the final fire stamps both done and total with the true count.
